governance.attested_by: miso-46 registration, MISO import-starvation root-cause session 2026-07-07 (G-23 residual)
governance.note: miso-46 = miso-45 keeper recipe with ONE structural change: miso_seam_measured_ladder ON (interchange_config.MISO_SEAM_LADDER_BY_YEAR, scripts/derive_miso_seam_ladders.py). Root cause (docs/multi-iso/miso-import-starvation-rootcause-2026-07.md): the measured PJM+IESO seam flow is a firm/scheduled base - imports in 97.5-99.5% of ALL hours (p10 0.9-1.7 GW), hourly flow uncorrelated with the RT LMP spread (r=+0.06), 2025 annual mean RT spread $0.00 while 28.0 TWh flowed, 46-56% of import MWh inside/below the $2 hurdle band - which the hurdle-gated spot-spread reference price structurally deletes in a zero-spread year (miso-45 2025: 3.4 TWh gross imports vs 19.0 actual net). The fix is the NEISO audit-C-6 measured-ladder pattern on MISO's three priced seams: band k of each seam/direction is priced at the measured MISO DA hub LMP quantile whose exceedance duration equals the measured EIA-930 duration of the seam flowing deeper than the band's midpoint (Q-Q duration coupling, frozen formula, zero fitted parameters - rule 23). Band capacities, the measured (month x hod) seam envelopes, and the Manitoba firm block are unchanged; every band still clears economically on the model's own hourly price (nothing forced - contrast the rejected miso_firm_import_floor min_gen pin). Rule-13 admissible: the ladder regenerates for a forward year (pooled 2023-2025 ladder = the persistent revealed seam structure; forecast years keep the gas-elastic formula, the hr_by_year two-track design) and responds to changed conditions.
governance.validation_note: Reproducible from the committed bundle: scripts/run_calibration_full.py --iso MISO --year 2023 2024 2025 --cc-capacity-reconcile --coal-econ-srmc-bound --reliability-floor --coal-prb-sigmoid --coal-mustrun-per-plant --coal-drop-pof --prb-sigmoid-tiered --coal-bit-sigmoid --ct-intermediate-split --cc-intermediate-split --st-gas-intermediate --energy-reserve-coopt --miso-zonal-reserves --miso-reserve-pergen --miso-zonal-gas-basis --reference-price-interface --miso-firm-imports --miso-seam-flow-limit --miso-seam-export-limit --miso-pjm-border-anchor --miso-seam-measured-ladder --out-dir results/calibration/MISO/miso_46_seam_ladder (needs ~16 GB: 15.76 GB VmHWM measured at the 2024 peak on this 15 GiB box - OOM-killed at 15.95 GB anon-RSS without swap; completed with a 10 GiB swapfile, <=190 MB actually swapped. G-40 datum.) RESULT vs miso-45: gross imports 3.4/15.5(net gm)/35.1 -> net interchange 2023 +35.2 (actual +37.9), 2024 +19.6 (actual +23.1), 2025 +13.2 (actual +19.0); 2025 PJM-seam imports 1.4 -> 16.7 TWh (actual PJM+IESO 28.0); South export restored -5.7/-8.4 TWh (actual -9.0/-11.8). 2025 coal barely moves (222.2 vs 224.4 TWh; family overrun ~+30 stays) - the restored imports displace GAS, not PRB: model PRB offers sit below even the $21.82 base import rung, so the remaining C2 coal 2025 miss is re-attributed to the coal-sigmoid offer level (#1347, C-1 ledgered DOF), NOT the import channel. Sigmoids NOT re-fit (rule 23: no source-data change).

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (benchmark basis mismatch — not a model miss)
exceptions.reason: EIA-930 MISO reports NO pumped-storage series (verified: the PS column is all-null in every scored year of the balance files); the 0.245 TWh actual is battery-only, while the model side includes the 2,417 MW EIA-860 PS fleet (Ludington + Taum Sauk). The model's PS throughput sits INSIDE the eGRID net-energy-implied gross-discharge band (2.5-4.4 TWh depending on RTE basis) — the model is not over-cycling. No adder is admissible (PSH O&M < $1/MWh; the PJM $10 adder precedent in constants.py retired exactly this class of fit-to-mismeasured-target). Closable only in the scorer: compare battery-only model discharge vs NG: BAT when a BA reports battery-only (flagged to rubric infra). Full adjudication: results/calibration/FINDING-miso-c5b-storage-benchmark-2026-07.md.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED MEASURED-INPUT LIMITATION (same basis mismatch as C5b)
exceptions.reason: The monthly shape compares model BAT+PS discharge against the battery-only EIA-930 series; the PS seasonal arbitrage shape dominates the model side and is absent from the actual. Rides the C5b scorer fix.

disclosures.note: MODEL MISS grounds for the NOT-YET determination. These are open structural root causes, not accepted measured-input limitations, and must keep scoring as FAILs until the mechanisms that own them land. The measured seam ladder CLOSED the G-23 import-starvation channel (net interchange 2023/2024/2025 +35.2/+19.6/+13.2 TWh vs actual +37.9/+23.1/+19.0, was +35.1/+15.5/+3.4 under miso-45) - the promotion is on that root-cause fix, not on the remaining FAILs closing. The restored imports displace gas, not PRB coal, so the coal/gas volume and price-level misses below WORSENED vs miso-45 and are re-attributed to the coal-sigmoid offer level (#1347, C-1 ledgered DOF - not refit, rule 23).
